headline: Mistakes to Avoid During Real Estate Closing Coordination in Aventura

publisher.name: Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution

articleBody:
The real estate closing process in Aventura, while exciting, can be fraught with potential missteps if you're not careful. It’s the final sprint, and while many think the heavy lifting is done after the contract is signed, the coordination required between then and closing is vital. Avoiding common mistakes here can save you time, money, and a lot of frustration.

**Common Mistakes to Avoid**
Firstly, missing contingency dates is a huge red flag. Whether it’s for inspections, appraisals, or financing, these deadlines are non-negotiable and missing them can jeopardize your deal. Keep a meticulous record or have someone do it for you. Secondly, failing to obtain a written earnest-money receipt can lead to disputes later on; always get confirmation. Another common pitfall is allowing title exceptions or repair agreements to remain unresolved. Any liens, easements, or agreed-upon fixes must be cleared before closing. Never assume "clear to close" means every single task is complete; it just means the lender is ready to fund. There might still be other actions required from you or other parties. Neglecting the final walkthrough is also a mistake. This is your last chance to ensure the property is in the agreed-upon condition and all repairs are done. Finally, and critically, never wire funds based on unverified instructions. Always double-check wire details via a trusted, independent phone call with the settlement agent to prevent fraud.

Effective closing coordination involves opening and organizing the file, verifying all signatures and dates, confirming earnest money, and meticulously tracking every deadline. It also means coordinating document delivery among everyone involved and ensuring lender clearance, arranging the final walkthrough, and verifying recording. A good coordinator helps you dodge these bullets.

Ensure your Aventura real estate closing is handled flawlessly. Contact Kelby Contreras to avoid these common mistakes and ensure a smooth transaction.
